purpose: Prepare D.4.3: a spatial experiment within the admitted domain, including boundaries and circuit, after global cell-stage acceptance.

remaining: Fresh registered ONE/TWO temporal and special-case validation of the selected guarded method
Dynamic electronic and phonon mesh convergence with paired temporal error control
Catalogue forces, field range and support checked on the final accepted method-specific trajectories
Updated global verdict linking all required gates and the accepted configuration
current_stage2_snapshot.scope_rule: The live global verdict is authoritative. Historical method-specific passes are preserved and are not transferred automatically to the guarded map, a finer mesh or the spatial stage.

entry_requirements.requires: stage2_admission.json numerical_admission is true, declares closure of the required numerical cell scope, and has no missing, failed or incomplete mandatory gate.
Record the admitted integrator, count/phonon quadratures, supports and cutoffs, source and input hashes, material conventions, relaxation and escape parameters, references and scope exclusions.
Retain cell-stage physical bounds, energy bookkeeping, conservative event geometry and independent consistency checks. Changed numerical representations require their own repeated relevant checks.
Review and freeze geometry, cell/boundary measures, scenarios, independent references, error scales, tolerances, support and stability policy, and runtime estimates before any spatial results.

preserved_inputs.material_scope: Traceable synthetic Debye inputs may be used for numerical tests; NbN absolute rates and detector latency require separate material admission.
preserved_inputs.history: Preserve failed methods and meshes. No clipping, hidden extrapolation, energy repair or removal of failed evidence.

first_bounded_work.name: Static discrete spatial energy, derivatives and admissibility
first_bounded_work.geometry: Small synthetic one-dimensional strip; a one-dimensional pilot cannot certify every direction of a later two-dimensional geometry.
first_bounded_work.populations: Frozen thermal and nonthermal occupations on the eventually admitted spectral representation
first_bounded_work.field_policy: Choose fields in the intersection of catalogue support and certified positive principal-symbol domain; register them before evaluation.
first_bounded_work.discrete_definition: Define cell/boundary measures and one discrete D.8 energy before deriving Cartesian forces and current. Check phase and vector-potential variations without adding a second GL current-depairing term.
first_bounded_work.reference: Independent variation/linearization of the same selected continuous equations; comparison with a different microscopic spatial model is a separate physical-model test.

draft_spatial_acceptance.error_scales: Declare physical/dimensionless scales before the run; scaled error uses max(1, absolute reference) in those declared units. Also report relative errors when references do not vanish.
draft_spatial_acceptance.refinement: The last two errors decrease unless below a preregistered roundoff/reference floor; document independent reference uncertainty.
draft_spatial_acceptance.principal_symbol: Certify lambda_min(M)>0 for directions in the declared geometry with numerical uncertainty smaller than the positive margin. Nonpositive or uncertifiable values reject the state; never clip rigidity.

mandatory_negative_control.expected: Reject the documented unstable state before time integration

later_stage3_gates_to_register: Boundary/interface flux and reservoir work balances D.24-D.27
Charge conservation and electric work D.22
Circuit storage and global energy balance D.28-D.33
Independent spatial, temporal, spectral and catalogue-error convergence
Central-region independence under longer one-dimensional continuations
Principal-symbol and catalogue-support validity at all required trajectory checkpoints

execution_policy.long_work: Record purpose, exact command, fresh output path, estimated runtime and resources; wait for user execution. Do not retry or split a timed-out calculation to evade handoff.

conclusion_limit: Only preparation is complete. Stage3 implementation remains blocked; nucleus/distribution-closure validation belongs to D.4.4, full detector transients and any production decision to D.4.5.
